topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can't believe I stumbled upon this old, battered teddy bear at a yard sale. Of all the places, here it is, staring at me with those worn, glassy eyes. It’s the same one I had, the one that saw me through every fear and every tear. It seems like just yesterday, but no, that was decades ago. I lost this bear, and now, here it is, looking small and forgotten. They’ve priced it cheap, but the value it holds is immeasurable. I snatched it up before anyone else could, clutching it tightly as if to reclaim a piece of my past. I’m not about to let it slip away again.
